details.Testing window: 1–8 September 2026. All seven tools were run on the same 150-source set during this window so detector models would not drift mid-cycle.
details.Sample count: 150 source texts × 7 tools = 1,050 primary outputs. Each output was scored on 5 detectors = 5,250 detector calls in the primary pass. A 40-text subset was rerun 3 times per tool for consistency (840 extra outputs).
details.How texts were selected: Stratified mixed corpus, dataset version humanizer-sept-2026-v1. 30 academic essays/short answers, 30 professional emails or memos, 30 blog/SEO explainers, 30 technical or policy briefs, 30 long-form opinion/narrative paragraphs. Sources were produced by three generator families (GPT-class, Claude-class, Gemini-class), then lightly copy-edited only to fix broken lists or truncated sentences. No source was written by hand to ‘beat’ a specific humanizer. Length band: 90–280 words (median 168). English only this cycle.
details.Inclusion / exclusion: Excluded poetry, code, tables-only pages, and texts already under 80 words. Excluded any sample that any humanizer refused to process (none of the seven refused the final 150).
details.Tool settings used: Each tool was run in its strongest advertised humanize / bypass mode, not the conservative ‘stay close to source’ mode. GPTHuman: College tone + Enhanced mode. StealthGPT: Super / highest stealth setting available on the tested plan. Humanize AI Pro: strongest humanize preset. HIX AI: HIX Bypass aggressive / bypass mode. BypassGPT: Enhanced (Aggressive used only when Enhanced was unavailable on that account). Netus AI: latest bypasser engine advertised in-product during the test week. NoteGPT AI Humanizer: default humanizer control with no extra style prompt. One pass only for the primary score; no cherry-picked rerolls except the separate consistency subset.
details.Manual vs API: Mixed. Detectors with a documented API (GPTZero, Originality.ai, Copyleaks, Winston AI where key access existed) were scored by API. ZeroGPT was scored through the public dashboard with the same paste protocol for every tool. Humanizers were used through each product’s official web app on a paid or trial seat so output would match what a normal user gets. No unofficial wrappers. Operators followed a fixed paste → set mode → generate → copy full output script. Outputs were stored before any manual edit.
details.Bypass score: Share of detector-runs on which the output was treated as a pass. Pass rule: AI probability < 20%, or an explicit Human / Likely human verdict when the product does not emit a probability. Five detectors × 150 samples. Bypass is a rate on that 750-run pool, scaled to 0–100.
details.Meaning score: Primary signal: sentence-transformer cosine similarity between source and output (all-mpnet-base-v2), scaled to 0–100. Secondary signal: two raters independently flagged intent/factual drift on a 20% random subsample (30 texts × 7 tools). A flagged drift capped that sample’s meaning contribution at 70 even if cosine was high. Final meaning is the mean of per-sample scores.
details.Readability score: Flesch Reading Ease computed on the output, clipped to 0–100. Penalized only through the separate length/verbosity flag when a tool inflated word count to game ease-of-reading. Grammar-broken outputs were not given a readability bonus.
details.Consistency score: On the 40-text stability subset, each tool produced three independent reruns with identical settings. Consistency combines (a) pairwise embedding similarity across the three outputs and (b) bypass-rate stability across those reruns. Large swings lowered the score. NoteGPT’s consistency is middling because tiny surface edits still produced unstable detector verdicts.
details.Overall formula: Raw = 0.40·Bypass + 0.25·Meaning + 0.20·Readability + 0.15·Consistency. Reported Overall = Raw − quality penalties (see Scoring adjustment sheet).
details.What this package is: A September ranking pack containing aggregate leaderboard results and a representative six-text evidence slice. The detector percentages in the evidence sheet are real test results for those six texts.
